title: Katra Creative Baton
description: The SANITISED, versioned context packet a stalled mission's controller picks candidates up from (ITER-7, Phase 5). Privacy: the baton is CONSTRUCTED field by field from an allow-list by creative-baton-compiler.ts — no private seed, trace, lineage or run field rides through, and the fields the brief marks private (evidence refs, changed premises, trace statements, the trace's own why_operationally_relevant, bridge text, parent links) have no place in this schema at all. The one field that may be shared is `shared_id`, stamped ONLY by the gated promoter, never by the compiler. Token discipline: `excluded_regions[].pattern` is a FINGERPRINT (kind + ordinal + a hash of the ruled-out text), never the text. Strictness: `additionalProperties` is FALSE at the top level and on every object in the shape, so an extra key is not merely dropped by the compiler — it fails validation at COMPILE, PROMOTE and READ time. That is deliberately stronger than a hash check: the payload hash is an UNSIGNED digest over the stored document, so a store-level writer can recompute it, and the closed schema is what then refuses the packet.

creative_baton_version.description: The baton FORMAT version (the brief's §4.3 `creative_baton_version`). A stored baton is promoted only if its version is one this deployment can validate.

baton_id.description: Derived: sha256 over the mission, the cycle, the compiled portfolio's seed ids and the problem-state digest. Never a random UUID.

user_id.description: The identity the baton was compiled FOR. It is the baton's owner until it is promoted; a promotion adds a team scope without moving the identity.

trigger.description: Why the cycle ran. `type` is the sanitised trigger label; `evidence` names the plateau conditions (and any force) that decided it — labels only, never private text.

problem_state_digest.description: The digest of the mission state the trace was built from (ITER-5's, copied verbatim — it is a hash, not private text).

excluded_regions.description: The regions the mission has ruled out, as FINGERPRINTS: kind, ordinal and a hash of the ruled-out text. The text itself never appears here.

attention_targets.description: What the cycle's trace pressed on, as CUES the compiler derives from the signal's kind and calibration numbers (never the signal's private statement or why text).

why_operationally_relevant.description: Compiler-derived: which kinds of decision this cue can change and which operator families press on it.

candidate_portfolio.description: The cycle's eligible candidates, in deterministic quality order. Each entry carries the candidate's own claim, mechanism, cheapest test and scores — the compiled material a controller acts on — and an explicit `privacy_safe: true`.

coverage_gaps.description: The descriptor bins no cell addresses yet — vocabulary strings and counts only. The compiler RE-VALIDATES every entry against the archive's closed DESCRIPTOR_BINS vocabulary and drops (counting) anything outside it, so a marker injected into a gap cannot ride into a shared packet.

coverage_summary.description: The bounded scan behind the gaps — cells seen, the scan's limits and whether a bound bit. A bounded scan is never silent.

next_round_budget.description: What the next round is allowed to spend, derived from the plateau rule and this cycle's eligible candidates.

counts.description: Planned vs actual, so an empty portfolio is never silent: how many admitted candidates were considered, how many cleared the floor, how many were dropped for carrying an id that is not derived-id-shaped, how many regions/cues were folded in, and how many coverage gaps/bins were dropped for being outside the archive's closed descriptor vocabulary.

coverage_gaps_considered.description: Gaps the coverage view offered (before the vocabulary re-validation).

coverage_gaps_dropped_unknown_dimension.description: Gaps dropped because their dimension is not one of the archive's DESCRIPTOR_DIMENSIONS.

coverage_bins_dropped_unknown.description: Bins dropped because they are not in DESCRIPTOR_BINS[dimension].

privacy.description: The baton's own privacy statement. `raw_reflections_included` is const false (a baton that claimed otherwise could not be stored); `shared` is false until the gated promoter stamps a shared scope.

payload_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical sanitised payload (the promotion-stamp fields excluded). The promoter recomputes it and refuses a stored baton whose hash no longer matches.

shared_id.description: Stamped ONLY by the gated promoter (`CREATIVE_BATON_PROMOTION`). Absent on every baton the compiler wrote.

stop_reason.description: Which stop condition of the cycle that compiled this baton fired first (null when none did).
